purpose: Complement fixed student-like stress cases with reactive conversations: subsequent utterances are chosen only after seeing the actual tutor reply.
authoring: Primary Codex agent simulates plausible learner utterances under these scenario states; no learner model, real-student data, or validated behavioral distribution.
protocol: Start vague when a student would plausibly omit context; provide missing details if the tutor asks.
Follow or misunderstand the actual reply rather than pretending a different question was asked.
Include short assent, incomplete reasoning, frustration, and natural closure without always producing perfect answers.
Do not use hidden reference answers to claim independent learning. Record adaptation rationale for every chosen follow-up.
Three to five turns per episode, unless execution failure prevents continuation. End explicitly after the scenario has produced enough evidence.
review: Whether the simulated reply plausibly follows the actual tutor response

cases.learner_state: Can supply add/edit/commit order and status when asked; initially conflates index and working file.
